legacy.party: Worldpay/Genius transaction-metered POS initiative / Five Guys
legacy.action: Internal initiative approval gate before any customer approach. Todd has defined a repeatable Worldpay/Genius transaction-metered POS initiative for qualified Worldpay customers, with Five Guys as the first candidate design and pilot account—not a one-account pricing exception or approved offer. This is not a payment-processing subsidy: the transaction is the usage meter and potentially the collection rail. The working model uses a separately stated fixed POS software fee per eligible card transaction, never a percentage or blended processing uplift, with a defined monthly floor and ceiling; collection beginning with production activity through existing payment/billing rails if technically feasible; three- or five-year price protection; device flexibility; API-first preservation of customer choice; and one global software foundation. An optional earned service-fee credit can reward faster activation. Business benefits to validate include earlier cash collection, less separate SaaS invoicing, lower accounts-receivable and collections exposure, processing retention, faster deployment, and a reusable Worldpay differentiation. Market research confirms that payments-funded/no-monthly POS is established at SMB scale (including Toast, SpotOn, Square, Shift4, and Global Payments/Genius); no public source reviewed showed the complete fixed-per-transaction/floor-and-ceiling/open/global model for an enterprise restaurant. Do not claim “industry first.” Use “transaction-metered POS software” and “no separate SaaS invoice,” since the customer still purchases software and the floor may operate like a minimum service charge. Todd recalls that the Five Guys PAR contract renews or ends in March 2027; Avery independently described spring 2027. First secure Ryan's approval to investigate: (1) can Worldpay/Genius physically, financially, legally, and operationally deliver the initiative; (2) does the business have the will to pursue it; and (3) is Five Guys the right first pilot? Do not present the concept to M.J. until these gates clear and Avery is aligned. Executive summary: system/account_intelligence/2026-08-10-worldpay-transaction-funded-pos-executive-summary.md. Market research: system/account_intelligence/2026-08-10-transaction-funded-pos-market-research.md. Closure evidence: Ryan reviews the initiative; an explicit stop/proceed decision is recorded; if proceeding, feasibility owners and a decision date are named; and the Five Guys contract calendar is verified.
